title: Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan: Term Length, Included Services and Carried Services
content:
**1. Term.** A term of the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan runs 365 calendar days on every one of the six plans.

**2. Included services.** The services included in one term are those the plan is written for, counted as whole services.

**3. Carried services.** Services left unused at the end of a term carry into the next term only on the plans that allow it, and no more of them carry than the plan's carrying ceiling. A service that carries stays usable for the period the plan sets.

| Plan | Included services per term | Term length (calendar days) | Unused services carry over | Most that may carry | A carried service stays usable for (calendar days) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Care Essentials Plan | 2 | 365 | No | 0 | 365 |
| Keyturn Care Routine Plan | 4 | 365 | Yes | 1 | 365 |
| Keyturn Care Complete Plan | 6 | 365 | Yes | 2 | 540 |
| Keyturn Care Turnaround Plan | 8 | 365 | Yes | 3 | 540 |
| Keyturn Care Fleet Plan | 12 | 365 | Yes | 4 | 730 |
| Keyturn Care Electric Plan | 5 | 365 | Yes | 2 | 540 |

### Points of judgement on the schedule

*Where a vehicle sits on the Keyturn Care Routine Plan and three of the four included services are unused at the end of the term.* The plan allows services to carry and its carrying ceiling is 1, so one service carries into the next term and stays usable for 365 calendar days; the remaining two do not carry.

*Where a vehicle sits on the Keyturn Care Fleet Plan and two of the twelve included services are unused at the end of the term.* The carrying ceiling of 4 is above the two left, so both carry, and each stays usable for 730 calendar days.

*Where a vehicle sits on the Keyturn Care Essentials Plan.* Its two included services do not carry at all, its carrying ceiling being 0.
